definition: Recollection of death as a contemplative theme.

example_phrases.pali: maraṇassati, bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṁsā
example_phrases.translation: when recollection of death is developed and cultivated, it bears great fruit and great benefit
example_phrases.notes: AN 6.19 opens with this claim before six bhikkhus say how they practice it.
